field_notes.structure: One row per honor level (id 0-600) × 5 quality tracks. Expanded to 3005 (honor_level, quality) records. Quality 1=R, 2=SR, 3=SSR, 4=UR, 5=UR+.
field_notes.hp_bonus: stat_id 50063 (Hero HP) — ADDITIVE flat HP bonus. Q ratios at same level: Q1:Q2:Q3:Q4:Q5 = 1:2.5:5:10:20. At max (lv600): R=16000 SR=40000 SSR=80000 UR=160000 UR+=320000.
field_notes.shard_cost_levelup: Honor Shards required to level up from (level-1) to this level. Tiers: lv0-99=10 shards, lv100-199=20 shards, lv200-299=30 shards, lv300-399=40 shards, lv400-600=50 shards.
field_notes.shard_cost_promote: Honor Shards required to promote (quality tier up). Tiers: lv0-99=20 shards, lv100-199=40 shards, lv200-299=60 shards, lv300-399=80 shards, lv400-600=100 shards.
field_notes.power: stat 50063 power_coeff=0.5, power_cala_type=1 (additive). Power contribution = hp_bonus × 0.5. This is the Hero HP stat not troop HP — affects hero survivability not troop combat.
field_notes.source_table: lw_hero_honorLevel — sole source, no cross-table dependencies.
